# justacamera.app

> A privacy-first, fully client-side web camera app. Test your webcam and
> microphone, view the live feed, take photos, and record video — entirely in
> the browser. Your photos, videos, audio, and camera frames never leave the
> device. No backend, no uploads, no accounts, no tracking.

## What it does

- Live camera preview with device selection (camera + microphone) and front/rear switching.
- Photo capture (ImageCapture with a universal canvas fallback), countdown, and mirror controls.
- Local video recording (MediaRecorder, dynamic codec selection), with pause/resume and playback.
- Local-only downloads (File System Access where available, `<a download>` fallback otherwise).
- A privacy-preserving diagnostics panel with a sanitized "Copy report" action.
- Capability-driven advanced camera controls (zoom, torch, focus, exposure, …) where supported.

## Privacy

- All processing is local. The app makes no network requests for any camera, photo,
  recording, playback, or download operation. There is no server.
- Device identifiers (deviceId, groupId) and raw device labels never leave the browser
  and are stripped from any diagnostic export.
